name: pulsedive_indicator
description: Is this IP/domain/URL/hash malicious — risk score + threats. Looks up an indicator of compromise (IOC) in Pulsedive and returns its risk level, contributing risk factors, associated threats, and intel feeds. Example: pulsedive_indicator({ indicator: "8.8.8.8", _apiKey: "your-key" })

indicator.description: The IOC to look up — an IP, domain, URL, or file hash. e.g. "1.2.3.4", "example.com", "http://bad.tld/x"

_apiKey.description: Pulsedive API key (free tier 50/day at pulsedive.com)

name: pulsedive_explore
description: Search Pulsedive threat DB with a query. Uses the Pulsedive Explore query language (boolean field filters) to find indicators matching criteria like type, risk, feed, or threat. Example: pulsedive_explore({ q: "type=domain and risk=high", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-key" })

q.description: Explore query, e.g. "type=domain and risk=high", "ioc=*.ru and threat=emotet"
